text: The Forest Hill, Leaside and North Toronto Arena Nominating Panel must select candidates for interview for the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its April 16, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to North York Community Council.

The Forest Hill, Leaside and North Toronto Arena Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board: Candidate # 5 Candidate # 30 Candidate #34 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 26, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.
